name: zero_experts_identity
description: Identity-expert contribution for MoE. expert_indices is int32 [num_tokens, top_k], expert_scales is float32 of the same shape, and hidden_states is [num_tokens, hidden_dim]. An expert slot is an identity expert when expert_indices[t,k] >= num_experts; its scale is summed in float32, and out[t,:] = cast(hidden_states[t,:].float() * total_scale, hidden_states.dtype). Returns a newly allocated tensor and does not mutate inputs. zero_expert_type is accepted for API compatibility but is not used by the native identity path. Suites exercise int32 indices, float32 scales and bfloat16 hidden_states.
